snippet.title: You Don’t Unlock Doors in This PS1-Style Horror Game
snippet.description:
CHWÆST is a late-90s inspired retro 3D horror where progress is biological.

You don’t unlock doors.
No keys — you feed the Biomass Core.

Instead of searching for keys, you collect organic resources and bring them back to a living core that controls the environment.

• PS1-style low poly horror
• Dithering and low resolution visuals
• Organic environment that reacts to the player
• Short, intense experience (30–60 minutes)

Wishlist on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4363010/CHWAEST_A_Creeping_Parasite_Horror/
